description: Remove one skill from the runtime group attached to a Thalovant hub. Every hub sharing the runtime loses this skill; other skill attachments are unchanged, and the change applies live on the hub in about 15 seconds with no hub restart. The API answers 202 with an operation_id, hub_id, runtime_group_id, previous_version (version is null) and state "removing": pass wait: true to poll the operation until it converges (state "removed", or an error carrying the operation's failure message), with a 120 s default timeout; otherwise follow it with thalovant_get_operation. Fails 404 when the skill is not installed on the hub (code hub_without_runtime_group when the hub has no runtime group). hubId must be the hub UUID — the authenticated hub routes reject slugs. Requires the hubs:write scope and a paid plan; scope is checked before plan, so a free-plan token sees 403, never 402. A hub-restricted token must cover every hub sharing the affected runtime group.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait when wait is true, 1000-600000 ms. Defaults to 120000.

wait.description: Poll the operation until the removal converges (removed or failed). Defaults to false.

name: thalovant_remove_hub_skill
title: Remove Hub Skill
